title: hypericum quadrangulum var. tetrapterum
intro: Hypericum quadrangulum var. tetrapterum, commonly known as Spiked St John's Wort, is a plant species belonging to the St John's Wort family (Hypericaceae). It is valued for its therapeutic properties, which include relief from anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation, making it a popular natural remedy for promoting mental and emotional well-being. The bioactive constituents of Spiked St John's Wort include hyperforin, hypericin, and flavonoids, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and neuroprotective effects. The plant's therapeutic actions are thought to be due to its ability to modulate neurotransmitter activity, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation.
